title: Cleander
summary: Raleigh names Cleander in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cleander, Gouernour of Bizantium, who agreed with Cherisophus to meet him at the mouth of the Riuer Calphas. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter X, §. XIV, sig. 443b–444b
